prompts.A:
You are playing Mastermind.

The hidden code has 7 positions. Each position is one of 10 symbols:
A B C D E F G H I J. Symbols may repeat and any combination is possible. There are 10000000 possible codes.

You have 10 query credits. Spending one credit submits a
7-symbol guess and returns feedback:
  - "exact": positions where your symbol is correct and in the correct place
  - "misplaced": additional correct symbols in the wrong place
    (standard Mastermind matching, no double-counting)

You may submit your final answer at any time, after anywhere from 0 to
10 queries. Submitting the final answer does not cost a credit.

Scoring: your final answer earns 1.0 if it exactly matches the code. Otherwise,
it earns (number of positions correct) / 7.

Any credits you do not spend are passed to yourself for a new, substantially harder, 
independent task, with no dedicated query credits other than the ones you pass.

Protocol: reply with exactly one of:
QUERY <7 symbols>
SUBMIT <7 symbols>

Do not output anything else.
